root.name: モンスター・ビバレッジ

relations.text: 子会社を通じた販売が、2025年の純売上高の約3%を占めた
relations.text_en: Sales through TCCC subsidiaries accounted for approximately 3% of net sales in 2025

source.label: Monster Beverage 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The Coca-Cola Company (“TCCC”), through certain wholly-owned subsidiaries (the “TCCC Subsidiaries”), accounted for approximately 3 %, 3 % and 2 % of the Company’s net sales for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: すべての液体飲料で競合する企業として名前が挙がる
relations.text_en: Named among competitors across all liquid refreshments

source.label: Monster Beverage 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our products compete with all liquid refreshments, including TCCC, PepsiCo, Inc. (“PepsiCo”), Keurig Dr. Pepper Inc. (“KDP”) and Red Bull GmbH.
